name: week
title: Registrations this week
subtitle: What needs a person, worst first. Read-only. Changes are made by asking Claude Code.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select item, ref, product, owner, detail, due_on as due, days_left from attention_queue order by rank, due_on, ref

sections.title: Due in the next 30 days
sections.sql: select due_on as due, days_left, label as what, ref, product, manager as owner from open_dates where days_left between 0 and 30 order by due_on, ref

name: calendar
title: The regulatory calendar
subtitle: Every open date for the next twelve months, with the rule behind it.

sections.title: Open dates
sections.sql: select due_on as due, days_left, label as what, ref, product, manager as owner, item as detail from open_dates where due_on <= current_date + 365 order by due_on, ref
sections.note: Renewal, levy, annual return, exemption and declaration dates come from the rules table. Invoices, conditions and commitments come from your own records.

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.sql: select severity, rule, ref, finding from compliance_findings order by case severity when 'breach' then 0 else 1 end, rule, ref

name: portfolio
title: The registration portfolio
subtitle: Every registration by regulator and market, what is waiting, and what is on pack.

sections.title: Registrations
sections.sql: select ref, regulator, market, status, product, product_name, holder, granted_on as granted, expires_on as expires, case when ace then 'yes' else '' end as exempt, label_in_market, sales_last_fy_cents as sales_last_year from registration_register order by regulator, ref

sections.title: Submissions waiting
sections.sql: select s.code, r.ref, s.kind, s.title, s.lodged_on as lodged, current_date - s.lodged_on as days_waiting, s.owner from submissions s join registrations r on r.id = s.registration_id where s.outcome = 'pending' order by s.lodged_on

sections.title: Invoices not paid
sections.sql: select f.code, r.ref, f.kind, f.period, f.currency, f.amount_cents as amount, f.due_on as due, f.due_on - current_date as days_left from fees f join registrations r on r.id = f.registration_id where f.paid_on is null order by f.due_on
